verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it working with Linear/Jira tickets and being tagged in Slack or Teams threads, so two of the three named workflow tools are covered. Both mentions are brief, and nothing in the pack describes how to connect these tools or how they feed context into Devin. The Devin MCP server evidence covers other agents accessing Devin, not Devin consuming external tools, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: any Google Drive integration, setup documentation for the Jira and Slack connections, evidence of broader tool integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
